section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1979
title: 24 ## Causes of Suicides : The total number of suicide cases reported during 1979 has been classified under different heads and the last category 'Other Causes covers the unspecified causes of suicides sharing 50·0 percent of the total suicides. Among the important causes of suicides 'Dreadful Diseases' was the major cause of suicides during 1979 which accounted for 15·4 percent of total suicides. The second important cause was 'Quarrel with Parents-in-laws' (8·3%) followed by "Quarrel with Spouse' (5·9%), 'Love Affairs' (5·7%), 'Poverty' (3·2%), 'Dispute over Property' (3·1%), 'Insanity' (2·6%), 'Fall in Social Reputation' (1·7%), 'Failure in Examination' (1·6%), 'Unemployment' (1·2%), 'Bankruptcy or Sudden change in Economic Position' (0·8%) and 'Deaths of Dear Persons' (0·5%). The detailed statistics are presented in Table-III.
